segments.he: וְשֶׁלֹּא יְלַמֵּד אֶת בְּנוֹ יְווֹנִית. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: כְּשֶׁצָּרוּ מַלְכֵי בֵּית חַשְׁמוֹנַאי זֶה עַל זֶה, הָיָה הוּרְקָנוֹס מִבַּחוּץ, וְאַרִיסְטוֹבֻּלוּס מִבִּפְנִים. בְּכׇל יוֹם וָיוֹם הָיוּ מְשַׁלְשְׁלִין דִּינָרִים בְּקוּפָּה, וּמַעֲלִין לָהֶן תְּמִידִים.
segments.en: § The mishna taught that during the war of Titus the Sages decreed «that a person should not teach his son Greek. The Sages taught» that this decree came about as a result of the following incident: «When the kings of the Hasmonean monarchy besieged each other» in their civil war, «Hyrcanus was outside of» Jerusalem, besieging it, «and Aristoblus was inside. On each and every day they would lower dinars in a box» from inside the city, «and» those on the outside «would send up» animals for them to bring the «daily offerings» in the Temple.
